title: Icy Field

sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Deep Frozen Ocean (over Water Surface), Frozen Ocean (over Water Surface), Frozen River (over Water Surface), Ice Spikes, Snowy Beach (over Beach), Snowy Plains (over Grassy Terrain), and Snowy Taiga (over Forest).

sections.heading: Type power
lines: Rock moves also count as Ice for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Bitter Malice and Chilling Water: 1.5× stronger.
Hydro Steam, Scald, and Steam Eruption: halved (0.5×).

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Ice-type.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Burning Jealousy, Eruption, Fire Pledge, Flame Burst, Heat Wave, Incinerate, Inferno Overdrive, Lava Plume, Mind Blown, Raging Fury, and Searing Shot change the field into Cave.
Dive breaks the field apart when Water Surface or Murkwater Surface lies beneath and the move connects, exposing whatever lay beneath it.
Bulldoze, Earthquake, Fissure, Magnitude, and Tectonic Rage break the field apart when Water Surface or Murkwater Surface lies beneath, exposing whatever lay beneath it.
Hydro Steam, Matcha Gotcha, Scald, and Steam Eruption change the field into Water Surface once their uses add up to 2 (Hydro Steam 1, Matcha Gotcha 1, Scald 1, and Steam Eruption 2).

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Ice Body restores 1/16 of its HP.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Elemental Seed: Speed +2 and is hurt by icy spikes.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.

substrateText: When the ice is melted or broken, the ground beneath it ({substrate}) is restored instead of the usual replacement.
